prose: TechSpot reports on Brandon Thomas's free open-source Adobe look-alikes, built with AI after frustration with Adobe's cancellation process. The page itself was not retrieved; the headline matches Ars Technica and Tom's Hardware coverage of the Artcraft release.
Basis: headline plus related coverage describing seven apps modelled on Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere and others, still unfinished.
highlights: Developer builds free Adobe-style apps with AI
Motivated by frustration over cancelling Adobe
Same release as Ars Technica and Tom's Hardware stories
